summary: Phase 7 (booking status alerts + customer payment tracking) tested end-to-end. Backend: new pytest file test_agent_phase7_alerts_payments.py, 25/25 passing. Covered: admin confirm/complete/cancel(with refund '₱7,000.00 was refunded' + reason, without refund 'No refund was issued') each creating exactly one agent notification with correct kind/ref; invalid transition creates no alert; fund request approve/reject -> fund_request.approved/rejected with amount/reason; GET notifications unread_count, mark-one-read, read-all, other agent's notification 404 and not listed, unknown id 404, RBAC admin 403/anon 401; payments list/add/delete, validation (amount 0/-5 422, bad method 422, > balance 400, > remaining 400, future date 400, bad date 400), cancelled booking 400, other agent's booking 404 on GET/POST/DELETE, status unpaid->partial->paid->partial->unpaid persisted in DB, audit booking.payment.add/delete, list has amount_paid/balance_due, ?payment=owing excludes paid & cancelled, invalid payment value 422, dashboard customer_balance_due/bookings_owing, admin detail payments/amount_paid/balance_due, admin guest-payment-status override 409. Phase5/6 regression passes; old phase4_step3 guest-payment test updated to expect 409. Frontend (desktop 1920 + mobile 390): bell with unread badge, panel lists alerts, clicking alert marks read (count 4->3) and navigates to booking detail; dashboard alert click (top-up rejected) navigates to /agent/top-ups; Mark all read clears badge and dots; dashboard Alerts card and 'Customers still owe' link -> Balance due tab active with only owing rows; payments card: dialog amount error + disabled save for > balance, method select (GCash), reference/note, save updates Paid/Balance due, Record button hidden when fully paid and on cancelled booking, delete (confirm) recomputes totals and status 'Partial'; bookings list Balance due column ('—' for cancelled); admin detail Guest payment card shows 'Due ₱2,500' and read-only Customer payments dialog (no inputs). Mobile: no horizontal overflow on dashboard/detail, mobile bell + panel + dialog fine. All data cleaned; agent balance 53604.00 == SUM(ledger).

minor.issue: Overpay guard is check-then-insert (payments_total read, then insert). Two concurrent requests can together exceed the balance due. Low risk for single agent UI; could guard with a per-booking lock/atomic counter.
notify_agent runs after the state change without try/except; a notification insert failure would return 500 even though the status/ledger change already committed. Wrap in try/except + log.

Bookings whose guest_payment_status was set to 'paid' manually before Phase 7 (e.g. BTB-DEMO-0001) have no payment rows: they show status 'paid' but balance_due = full total, and are excluded from owing filter/dashboard. Consider a one-off migration (sync_payment_status for all) or treat legacy 'paid' consistently.

issues: Shows raw method key ('cash', 'bank_transfer') and ISO date (2026-10-29); agent side uses 'Cash' / 'Oct 29, 2026' — reuse METHODS labels + fmtDate. Reference/note not shown in admin list rows (reference is returned by API)
'Paid on' uses native <input type=date> rather than shadcn Calendar/Popover
Sonner toast ('Payment removed.') overlaps header action buttons for a few seconds (known from iteration 9)
Alerts card sits far down the page below balance/stat cards; acceptable since bell is in top bar
